sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 85 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: The original inner border follows unused shortcut and chicane branches across the retained full-course corridor. Complete independent sparse image observations reconstruct selected full-course road limits, with denser final-chicane observations; source trace and draft identity are preserved.

measurement.note: Nurburgring GP: 345 sparse image observations and two repeated closure anchors independently located on raw pinned licensed-image cross-sections at roughly 30 m spacing, with additional 15 m observations and closer curb-side interpretation around the final chicane. Limits follow visible paint, the asphalt side of curbs and surface/grass transitions, excluding adjoining runoff, pit and service roads. Offsets read to 0.5 m; image sampling and rounding do not establish survey accuracy. No anchor is claimed at positive-normal stations 10 and 210 (openings), 1540 and 1550 (shadow), or negative-normal stations 840, 1320 and 1650 (junctions/merge); the additional station 1285 negative-normal edge and 1315 negative-normal edge also remain unobserved junction openings. Both edges at stations 280 and 1510 are unobserved bridge occlusions. Those gaps and all other unmeasured intervals interpolate. Paint and image interpretation remain uncertain. Original draft route identity is retained. No automatic border coordinates were used.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
